page.layout: One printed page, one text column at left-centre; running head at top; a catchword-like signature "AD" at lower right of the column, set off from the text. No margin notes.

main_text.p: cem, non autem secundum humanam naturam assumptam.
main_text.head: III.
main_text.p: An corpus Christi exhibeatur in cœna corporaliter, an verò tantum efficaciter secundū virtutem & efficaciam, non secundum substantiam.
main_text.head: IIII.
main_text.p: An corporalis manducatio sine spirituali profit vel obsit magis.
main_text.head: V.
main_text.p: An sextum caput Ioannis rectè referri possit ad corporalem manducationem in cœna.
main_text.head: VI.
main_text.p: An κοινωνία apud Paulum 1.Cor.10. sit intelligenda non tantum de fructu & efficacia, sed potius de substantia corporis Christi.
main_text.head: VII.
main_text.p: An etiam mali & impij corpus Christi verum, & sanguinem eius verum percipiant.
main_text.head: VIII.
main_text.p: An fides dantium vel accipientium faciat sacramentum, vel potius sola institutio & verba Christi.
main_text.head: IX.
main_text.p: An adoratio Christi præsentis in cœna sit approbanda.

page.notes: The Greek word in VI is printed as "xoινωνία" with an accent-like mark; transcribed as κοινωνία. The "AD" at the lower right is a signature-type mark placed below the text. Page number not printed.
